nodes.description: Internal view helper that returns msg.sender and is the sole entry point of caller identity into Ownable and ERC20.
Private address holding the privileged owner account used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Public view returning _owner; consumed by the onlyOwner access check.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); the only access-control gate in the contract.
Owner-only function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently dropping privileged control.
Owner-only function that reassigns _owner to a new address, transferring all privileges.
Mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of spender allowances written by _approve and read by transferFrom/increase/decreaseAllowance.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn; read by Ninjasy cap check.
Public transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public approval that forwards caller, spender and amount to _approve.
Public allowance-based transfer that reads _allowances, performs allowance subtraction and calls _transfer/_approve.
Adds addedValue to the caller-spender allowance and writes it via _approve.
Reads the caller-spender allowance, requires it covers subtractedValue, then writes the reduced value via _approve.
Internal balance-moving routine that hooks _beforeTokenTransfer and updates both sender and recipient balances.
Internal supply-increasing routine that hooks _beforeTokenTransfer, raises _totalSupply and credits the account.
Internal supply-reducing routine that hooks _beforeTokenTransfer, debits the account and lowers _totalSupply.
Internal allowance writer that stores amount in _allowances[owner][spender].
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn; overridable callback surface.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by _beforeTokenTransfer when tokens move to _uni.
Private address of the restricted destination (university/AMM) controlled by the owner.
Deploys the Ninjasy token, minting the full initial supply to 0x8DEf... and whitelisting that address.
Override enforcing the 100000000000000e18 cap before delegating to ERC20._mint via super.
Owner-only external mint that routes into the capped _mint override.
Owner-only function that adds or removes an address from the _enable whitelist.
Owner-only function that sets the restricted transfer destination _uni.
Override that requires _enable[from] whenever the recipient equals _uni, gating transfers to the restricted address.
Caller-supplied identity read through _msgSender() and compared against the owner in onlyOwner.
Arithmetic cap expression ERC20.totalSupply() + amount <= 100000000000000 * 10**18 guarding minting.
Balance decrement _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount in _transfer.
Balance increment _balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer.
Allowance decrement currentAllowance - amount performed before writing the new allowance.
Supply increment _totalSupply += amount inside ERC20._mint.
Balance decrement _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside _burn.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned directly by _msgSender().
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() with owner() to authorize the caller.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the source of the transfer.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom passes _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance lookup.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() for both allowance reads and writes.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() to read and re-approve the allowance.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier reads owner() before allowing execution.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership so only the owner can renounce.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership so only the owner can transfer privileges.
onlyOwner gates Ninjasy.mint, restricting privileged supply creation.
onlyOwner gates Ninjasy.list, restricting whitelist changes.
onlyOwner gates Ninjasy.uni, restricting the restricted destination address.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into _owner.
Ownable constructor obtains the deployer identity through _msgSender().
Ownable constructor stores _msgSender() into the msgSender local.
The msgSender local is written into the _owner state variable.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom moves balances through _transfer.
transferFrom reads the caller allowance from _allowances.
transferFrom rewrites the reduced allowance via _approve.
transferFrom copies the allowance into the currentAllowance local.
transferFrom performs currentAllowance - amount which can underflow on unvalidated amounts.
The currentAllowance local is an operand of the allowance subtraction.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.
increaseAllowance writes the increased allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.
decreaseAllowance stores the allowance into the currentAllowance local.
The reduced allowance local is passed into _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount for the sender balance.
The subtracted sender balance is stored back into _balances.
_transfer adds amount to the recipient balance, an unchecked-by-design accumulation.
The recipient credit is written into _balances.
_transfer stores _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local.
senderBalance is the operand of the balance subtraction.
_transfer dispatches to the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, which Ninjasy implements.
ERC20._mint reads and writes the _totalSupply state variable.
ERC20._mint performs _totalSupply += amount.
The increased supply value is written back into _totalSupply.
ERC20._mint credits the beneficiary in _balances.
ERC20._mint performs _balances[account] += amount.
The minted balance is stored into _balances.
ERC20._mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook implemented by Ninjasy.
_burn reads and writes _balances.
_burn performs accountBalance - amount on the account balance.
The reduced balance is written back into _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn stores _balances[account] into the accountBalance local.
accountBalance is the operand of the burn subtraction.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook implemented by Ninjasy.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
Ninjasy._mint delegates to the base implementation via super._mint.
Ninjasy._mint evaluates the totalSupply + amount cap arithmetic.
Ninjasy._mint reads ERC20.totalSupply() for the cap comparison.
Ninjasy.mint routes the capped minting through the _mint override.
Ninjasy.list writes the enable flag into the _enable whitelist mapping.
Ninjasy.uni writes the new restricted destination into _uni.
Ninjasy._beforeTokenTransfer compares the recipient against _uni.
Ninjasy._beforeTokenTransfer reads the _enable whitelist for the sender.
The Ninjasy constructor mints the initial supply through the capped _mint override.
The constructor whitelists the initial holder in _enable.
Constructor chaining runs the inherited Ownable constructor during deployment.
